description: Canonical role -> field projection for pillar 6 (agent consumption). Agents fetch a role-scoped slice of a locked spec rather than the full document. Field paths are dotted paths into a schema v0.2.0 proposal payload; a spec locked under v0.1.0 projects through the same map, because a field the stored spec does not carry is omitted. Consumed by weyucou/ibuki-backend (vendored, drift-checked in CI); documented for humans in docs/agent-consumption.md.
